subject.title: [Feature]: `announceTarget` option for sub-agent completion announce routing

question: Should OpenClaw accept a public native `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"` contract for native `sessions_spawn` and `agents.*.subagents`, or keep parent handoff behavior internal/workaround-only?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds durable tool/config semantics and routing behavior in a config-sensitive agent orchestration path where repository policy requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept narrow opt-in parent routing
options.body: Review and land the linked PR or equivalent with `channel` as the default, parent routing as explicit opt-in, and coverage for thread-bound and restart/persistence cases.

options.title: Keep behavior internal for now
options.body: Close or pause the linked PR and leave users on documented `sessions_send` or channel-specific workaround patterns until a broader handoff design is chosen.

options.title: Split routing from config default
options.body: Accept only a per-spawn model-facing option first and defer config-level defaults until upgrade and operator-policy implications are clearer.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow opt-in parent routing
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR or equivalent with `channel` as the default, parent routing as explicit opt-in, and coverage for thread-bound and restart/persistence cases.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced `sessions_spawn`, recently refactored announce delivery, and commented on this issue with the focused implementation shape.
